newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Smit Int plans two for one share split.
newsitem.headline: Smit Int plans two for one share split.

text.p: Dutch shipping group Smit Internationale said on Tuesday it planned a two-for-one share split.
It said the split was one of a number of proposals to revise its articles of association to be submitted to shareholders for approval on May 28.
- conversion of the priority share into ordinary shares
- a split in the ordinary shares in the ratio 1:2
- introducing the possibility of issuing so-called anti-takeover preference shares and financial preference shares
- scrapping the existing depositary receipts of share and introducing ordinary bearer shares," the company said in a brief statement.

The priority share, with a nominal value of 10,000 guilders, is owned by a special trust and carries special voting rights, including the right to veto major corporate decisions such as a new share issue.
